intendedUse: auditable stage-1 native-image scale registry; NOT live simulator needle geometry
angleConvention: 0 degrees points up (12 o'clock); positive clockwise; image y increases downward. Angles are bearings from the pivot of the cited measurement, not universal SVG rotations.
safeguards: All image-derived bearings are candidates; none passes the complete all-tick native-pixel visual sign-off.
Never derive gauge zeros from display power-off state or an assumed 12 o'clock pose.
No missing center/angle is replaced by a fabricated value.
The two OH19 concentric scales use independent angle maps.
Retained-pressure, temperature, and aircraft elevation are physical states, not universal numeric zero.
